content: Semi-implicit Euler spring-damper stability: undamped limit omega*dt < 2; damped discrete system stable for 0<c_t<2 and 0<k_t<4-2c_t (Jury conditions on the 2x2 update matrix, derived); web sources agree on omega dt<2 and that semi-implicit Euler is stable for any b>=0 only when k is small enough.
